scenes.headline: How a small model learns from its big sibling
scenes.sub: Inkling-Small: on-policy distillation from Inkling, then agentic coding RL.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Donut! Inkling-Small is an open model that now beats its bigger sibling at reasoning and coding. The trick is in how it was taught.

scenes.text: In on-policy distillation the student writes its own answers, and the teacher only scores the tokens the student actually produced.
scenes.mark: the student writes its own answers
scenes.say: In on-policy distillation, the student writes its own answers, and the teacher only scores the tokens the student actually produced.

left.title: Off-policy distillation
items: The student learns to copy those exact tokens
One different token, and it's off the map
left.say: Ordinary distillation has the teacher write, and the student copy. But once the student samples one different token, it's in a state training never showed it.

right.title: On-policy distillation
items: The student writes its own rollout
The teacher scores each token the student wrote
No teacher transcript to drift away from
right.say: On-policy flips it. Wherever the student's own sampling leads, that is exactly where it gets graded and corrected.

scenes.title: One teacher, grading the student's own tokens

steps.say: The student, Inkling-Small, gets a task and writes its own answer, one token at a time.
The teacher, the full Inkling, reads that rollout and scores each token the student produced.
Those scores train the student. For a long reasoning trace, where every step builds on the last, that matters most.

items.say: Start from the same design, cut narrower: forty-two layers instead of sixty-six, the same two hundred fifty-six experts.
Post-train an earlier checkpoint, partly by on-policy distillation, with Inkling as the only teacher.

items.text: Two weeks of agentic coding RL
items.say: Then two weeks of agentic coding RL. The lab gives the duration, not the compute.

scenes.title: Small against Inkling: coding up, recall down
scenes.note: vendor-reported, on Thinking Machines' own suite
scenes.say: It shows. Inkling-Small beats Inkling on SWE-Bench Verified, eighty point two to seventy-seven point six. On factual recall, it scores twenty point six to Inkling's forty-three point nine.

scenes.text: Distillation here never aimed to know what the teacher knows. It aimed to write trajectories the teacher scores well.
scenes.say: The goal was never to know what the teacher knows, but to write what it scores well. That's where the gains landed.

recap: The student writes; the teacher scores its tokens
No teacher transcript, so no drift off it
Gains in reasoning and coding, not in recall
scenes.say: To recap: the student writes, the teacher grades, and the gains land in reasoning, not recall.
